title: indigo_agent_scheduler: SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md does not mention the global MIN_ALTITUDE and MAX_ALTITUDE settings
description: Commit c913ed677 added the global MIN_ALTITUDE and MAX_ALTITUDE settings (and the UNREACHABLE task state) to the Scheduler Agent. indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md still says INDIGO has only a minimum altitude per task (section 5 'No horizon profile'). Update the wording: section 5, the constraint row of the feature table and the score notes should mention the global altitude band (with the ceiling for the zenith blind spot or a roof edge) and state that it is the same at every azimuth, so it is not a horizon profile. Scores stay unchanged: the constraint score is held at 2 by the missing azimuth-dependent horizon profile and per-filter limits, and the projected gains of a horizon profile stay as they are. Documentation only.

outcome.summary: Diff touches only indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md (+6/-5). Verified against c913ed677: item names MIN_ALTITUDE/MAX_ALTITUDE of AGENT_SCHEDULER_SETTINGS (indigo_names.h:1539,1552-1553); limits hold for the whole run like @altitude (INDIGO_SCHEDULER_GUIDE 'Global altitude limits'), so the section 3 bullet is correct; UNREACHABLE for targets that can never stand within the band matches the guide; the band is a pair of scalar altitudes, azimuth-independent, so 'not a horizon profile' is accurate; MAX_ALTITUDE purpose (zenith blind spot of alt-az/fork mount, roof or dome edge) matches the guide wording. Section 5, the professional feature-table constraint row (line 230) and all three score notes (277, 317, 355) are updated; no remaining statement says INDIGO has only a per-task minimum altitude. No score cell or total changed; horizon-profile gains (lines 293, 327, 376) unchanged as required. English, style and Markdown (table column count, list) are correct. Not in scope: a pre-existing typo 'frakvme counts' at line 308/309 of the capability table exists on master too.

Re-review after the approved typo fix. The diff master...HEAD (no uncommitted changes) touches only indigo_drivers/agent_scheduler/doc/SCHEDULER_COMPARISON.md: the global MIN_ALTITUDE/MAX_ALTITUDE band is mentioned in the constraint list, section 5, the professional capability table cell and the three score explanations, plus 'frakvme counts' -> 'frame counts'. No score or total changed; all modified table rows keep their column counts. Names match the source (AGENT_SCHEDULER_SETTINGS, MIN_ALTITUDE/MAX_ALTITUDE items, UNREACHABLE state). No defects.
